# start/quickstart.md

Hand-authored.

The [`build:box`](/reference/cli/build-box/) command word is linked here on purpose:
it is a colon-carrying `noun:verb` word, and this link is written at the SANITIZED
spelling the page is served at. If the emitter ever writes that page at its raw
spelling again, this link stops resolving and the generate run's link gate fails —
so the fixture proves the page path and the link target agree, rather than asserting
it separately.
